notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (amounts on p5, labels on p4). Debt proceeds 190,000 is printed inside Total Receipts 14,435,105.49, so it is in debt_proceeds and reported total includes debt_proceeds. 'Taxes: Other' 2,852,808.09 split using the General Fund budget schedule (p8: homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate, carline) plus Special Building pro rate 208.32 (p16); homestead/credit/pro-rate recorded as intergovernmental/state aid. 'Other student support' split into Activities (837,892.61) and School Nutrition (571,928.24) disbursements; 'Debt Service' split into principal and interest from the Special Building Fund (p16). Transfer of 250,000 General to Depreciation Fund is eliminated in Exhibit D (nets out); top-level transfers null. Exhibit E (p6-7) is a General Fund components schedule showing the transfer and reclassifications (150,000 transportation, 100,000 facilities); Exhibit G budget schedule (General incl. Depreciation transfers) still carries those amounts inside spending (4700 Building improvements 100,000 = whole facilities reclass; transportation group lines 2710-2733 hold 150,000, line unknown), so contra lines and an other-financing -250,000 are recorded in detail and the General Fund expenditure total (11,414,634.70) is flagged includes other financing. Exhibit E itself not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. General Fund detail: Exhibit N (program x object, p18-19) is used for programs 1100-2142 but the trimmed PDF stops partway through Exhibit N (after Psych Services SPED 3-5), so programs 2151 onward come from the Exhibit G budget schedule as 'not itemized' with budget_final. Exhibit N object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance; Other Expenses -> dues, training and travel; Other/Purchased Professional Services -> professional/contract services. Revenue lines with zero actual in Exhibit G (e.g. 1990, 1925, 4525, 4530, 5320) were skipped. Bond Fund (Ex. K) had no activity. Activities Fund receipts have no revenue breakdown (shown as student activity receipts, charges for services). Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), no liabilities printed. Read pages 1-19 of 19
